definition: For each foreground label compute case Dice 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); take nanmean across cases for each label; then arithmetic mean across foreground labels.
aggregation: class-balanced mean of five nnU-Net class means
empty_gt_empty_pred: NaN and excluded from that class mean
historical_use: Primary headline metric for 2D/3D/A/C/D/E full-case validation
stage3_role: Secondary required outcome and checkpoint-independent final report
comparability_and_audit_finding: It includes absent-class false positives but excludes true-negative empty/empty pairs; it is not a patient-present macro and is not online EMA.

definition: For class c retain patients with n_ref(c)>0 and average 2TP/(n_ref+n_pred).
aggregation: one mean per class over its GT-present patients
historical_use: Used in oracle and case-level mechanism analysis
stage3_role: Required secondary outcome and feeds primary Stage3 macro
comparability_and_audit_finding: Uses common GT-defined support across models.

definition: Compute PER_CLASS_GT_PRESENT_DICE for each of labels1-5 then take an unweighted mean across the five classes.
aggregation: class first then unweighted five-class mean
historical_use: Primary metric for the locked complementarity oracle
comparability_and_audit_finding: Differs from averaging all present patient-class rows because rare classes receive equal class weight.

definition: Pool every patient-class pair with n_ref>0 and take the arithmetic mean of pairwise Dice.
aggregation: each present patient-class pair has equal weight
comparability_and_audit_finding: Common support but frequent classes receive more weight than rare classes; must not be labeled class-balanced.

definition: Within each patient average Dice over that patient's GT-present classes; then average patients.
empty_gt_empty_pred: patients without any foreground would be excluded
comparability_and_audit_finding: This is not the class-balanced present macro used by the oracle; historical files correctly label them separately but prose must keep the distinction.

definition: Within each model and patient average all finite class Dice values then average patients.
empty_gt_empty_pred: excluded only for classes where that model and GT are both empty
historical_use: Direction probe and case-level descriptive views
stage3_role: Not an endpoint for Stage3 success
comparability_and_audit_finding: Supports can differ by model because a false positive converts NaN to zero; direct causal comparison is unsafe unless labeled.

definition: For each patient-class with n_ref=0 record any n_pred>0 and FP voxel/physical volume; summarize case fraction and volume.
aggregation: paired on the same absent patient-class support
empty_gt_empty_pred: correct true negative recorded as no FP
historical_use: Used in E case analysis oracle and binary-union diagnostic
comparability_and_audit_finding: Must remain separate from GT-present delineation; improvement here cannot substitute for positive present-macro gain.

definition: Per class form 26-connected 3D GT and prediction components; Hungarian one-to-one matching maximizes intersection and accepts a pair iff intersection>0; TP=matched pairs FP=unmatched predictions FN=unmatched GT; F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN) and recall=TP/(TP+FN).
aggregation: pool component counts within each patient first; report patient-cluster summaries and per class
empty_gt_empty_pred: if both have no components the patient-class is excluded
gt_absent_pred_present: no GT components handled in absent FP not lesion F1
historical_use: Not present in formal historical tables
comparability_and_audit_finding: This exact definition is newly preregistered and must be implemented/tested before use; do not infer it from voxel Dice.

definition: LESION_LEVEL_RECALL restricted to individual GT components with physical volume <1.0mL; matching rule unchanged.
aggregation: per class and pooled GT lesions with patient as inference cluster
historical_use: Historical binary-union report used whole-patient <1mL groups not lesion-component recall
comparability_and_audit_finding: Do not relabel the old n=4 patient subgroup as lesion-level recall.

definition: For a GT-present class compute bidirectional surface-to-surface distances in physical coordinates and take the 95th percentile of their union.
aggregation: per patient-class then class-specific and class-balanced summaries
gt_present_pred_empty: assign the physical image diagonal as a locked failure penalty
gt_absent_pred_present: not summarized here; use absent FP
historical_use: Posthoc binary-union diagnostic has physical HD95 for nonempty predictions; generic evaluation helper does not
comparability_and_audit_finding: The generic evaluation/metrics.py value is maximum Hausdorff in voxel coordinates and is forbidden as HD95; Stage3 needs a new tested implementation.

definition: Normalized surface Dice: fraction of GT and prediction surface elements lying within 3.0mm of the opposite surface using physical spacing.
aggregation: per GT-present patient-class then class-balanced summary
gt_absent_pred_present: not summarized here; use absent FP
historical_use: Not computed in locked historical experiments
comparability_and_audit_finding: Tolerance is fixed at 3.0mm before results; a 1mm sensitivity may be reported but cannot replace the preregistered endpoint.

definition: Each validation epoch pools hard TP/FP/FN across sampled validation patches for each foreground class; nanmean classes gives mean_fg_dice; EMA_t=0.9*EMA_(t-1)+0.1*mean_fg_dice.
aggregation: patch-level pooled counts then class mean and temporal EMA
gt_present_pred_empty: contributes zero Dice when denominator exists
gt_absent_pred_present: contributes zero Dice when denominator exists
historical_use: Checkpoint selection and early stopping only
comparability_and_audit_finding: Not full-volume patient Dice and must never be placed in performance tables beside summary Dice.

definition: evaluation.metrics.binary_metrics uses safe_div and returns 0 when denominator is zero.
historical_use: Only generic evaluation scripts; not the locked nnU-Net headline tables
stage3_role: Forbidden for Stage3 without explicit metric renaming/fix
comparability_and_audit_finding: Empty policy conflicts with nnU-Net NaN and can depress or alter means.

definition: Maximum of two scipy directed_hausdorff distances on np.argwhere voxel indices.
aggregation: mean of defined nonempty cases in binary script
gt_present_pred_empty: undefined None when either mask empty
comparability_and_audit_finding: It is not HD95 and ignores affine/spacing; historical formal comparisons did not use it.
